description.value: Cedar Cottage Liquor Store is the retail liquor arm of the Cedar Cottage complex on Clark Drive in Vancouver, which also houses a neighbourhood pub and coffee house. The store carries a broad selection of craft, import, and domestic beer, wines, spirits, and liqueurs from around the world, and runs regular product tastings and contests. Staff are noted for being knowledgeable and accommodating of special orders, making it a practical stop for stocking up on a multi-day tour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at cedarcottagepub.ca confirms Cedar Cottage Liquor Store is a real, operating business, part of a larger Cedar Cottage complex (pub + coffee house + liquor store). A critical address discrepancy exists: the OSM record places the store at 1295 Clark Drive, while the website consistently lists 3728 Clark Drive across every page including the contact page — suggesting the OSM geometry or address tag is wrong. The liquor store page mentions parking (car-focused), a wide product selection, and tasting events, but says nothing about bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or water access.
concerns: Significant address discrepancy: OSM record places the store at 1295 Clark Drive, but the website consistently lists 3728 Clark Drive across all pages (main page, contact page, footer). The OSM addr:housenumber tag is likely wrong and should be corrected.
URL was discovered with only medium confidence; the address mismatch raises the possibility that this website was matched to the wrong OSM node, though the business name matches exactly.

OSM has no phone number; the website lists two numbers — 604.876.1411 (pub/main line) and 604.879.9463 (liquor store line used at the bottom of the liquor store page). The liquor store-specific number (604.879.9463) is used here.
Website content appears dated (copyright 2015, staff picks are static), though the OSM check_date of 2025-09-13 suggests the physical location was verified recently.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating liquor store with an active website and recent OSM check date (2025-09-13). Address discrepancy should be corrected but does not affect inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Cedar Cottage complex at 3728 Clark Drive includes a neighbourhood pub (with free Wi-Fi noted on the pub page), a coffee house, and this liquor store. A cyclist visiting the complex could potentially access pub amenities, but these are not confirmed for the liquor store specifically.

wow_evidence: retail liquor arm of the Cedar Cottage complex (pub + coffee house + liquor store)
